 3 PS Plus Extra Game Removals for December 2026 Confirmed 
 Just a shortlist this time around
 by Liam Croft 
 3 hours ago 
 Share:
 The bulk of your PS Plus Extra and PS Plus Premium titles for this month are available now, which means it is now time to learn what PS5, PS4 titles are leaving the service in December.
 It's a very short list compared to what the Last Chance to Play section normally looks like, with only three titles tipped to leave PS Plus Extra next month. All departing on 15th December 2026, you'll lose access to the following games:
 Granblue Fantasy: Relink (PS5, PS4)
 Somerville (PS5, PS4)
 Fade to Silence (PS4)
 Unlike the PS Plus Essential tier, in which you gain access to the games for as long as you subscribe to the service after redeeming them, the PS Plus Extra tier revokes access once the titles depart. If you want to continue playing any of the above, you'll have to buy them after 15th December 2026.
 Of the three games on the list, Granblue Fantasy: Relink is a quality RPG that will take you a good chunk of time to fully complete. Somerville, meanwhile, is a short story-focused adventure that's also well worth checking out. I would focus on playing those two games over Fade to Silence, which is a very average survival experience.
